entries.name: Glute Bridge
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on Family 29 supine chain (spine 24.00, neck 9.00, thigh 18.03, shin 19.72 exact); the lifted bridge trunk sits 120 degrees off vertical so the L3 upright rule never claims the bent knee. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a glute bridge.

frames.caption: Lie on the back with the feet planted close to the fingertips.
Tuck the pelvis before anything else moves.
Drive the floor away through the planted heels.
Hold level hips at the top between knees and shoulders.
Lower on a slow count with the hips level.

entries.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 12 degrees so the bench under the upper back, the padded barbell across the hips, the plates, and the vertical shins at lockout all read clearly: driving through the heels from lowered hips until thighs and torso form a level tabletop from knee to shoulder, pausing a full beat at the top with the chin tucked, and lowering under control.
entries.summary: With your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips, drive through your heels until thighs and torso form a level tabletop with vertical shins, pause a full beat at the top, and lower under control.

frames.caption: Sit with your upper back against a bench, feet planted, and a padded bar over your hips.
Drive through your heels until your thighs and torso are level with the floor, finishing flat like a tabletop.
Tuck the pelvis and pause a full beat at the top in one straight line from knee to shoulder with vertical shins.
One straight line knee-to-shoulder, core braced in neutral, drive through the heels with vertical shins, and chin tucked.
